load_json_to_dataframe: load a JSON file into a pandas DataFrame with optional index and sorting
load_json_to_dataframe_with_index: load a JSON file into a DataFrame and set a specific column as the index
load_json_to_dataframe_sorted: load a JSON file into a sorted DataFrame by its index column
load_compressed_json_to_dataframe: load a compressed JSON file like json.gz into a pandas DataFrame
review_load_json_to_df: review the load_json_to_df function to understand its index and sorting behavior
